rules.name: Ire of Commoragh
rules.description: Your army may not take an allies from Codex – Dark Eldar.

rules.name: Vanishers
rules.description: Your army may take allies from Codex – Imperial Guard, Codex - T’au Empire and Codex – Orks.

rules.name: Death’s Court
rules.description: A Reapers Mirth army may field Death Jester units as Troops choices, but they gain the Support Squad special rule.

rules.name: Before Darkness Reigns
rules.description: If Night Fighting is effect, it must be Dusk.

rules.name: Reaver Rivalry
rules.description: Your army may not take an allies from Codex – Dark Eldar.

rules.name: Constant Performance
rules.description: This unit always Sets to Overwatch at the end of the Shooting Phase, even if it made a Shooting attack in that phase. If it did so, it Overwatch Attacks are resolved as if they had the Gets Hot! Special rule.

rules.name: Rift Ghoul
rules.description: A model with this upgrade gains the Bane special rule on its equipped Shrieker Cannon (Shrieker) profile.

rules.name: Harvester of Souls
rules.description: A model with this upgrade gains the Arcing (4+) special rule on its equipped Shrieker Cannon (Shuriken) profile.

rules.name: Gloomspider
rules.description: One Shadowseer model in your army may be upgraded to the Gloomspider. Enemy units affected by this units Deny the Witch special rule subtract 2 from their Leadership (LD) characteristic when making a Psychic Test.

rules.name: Agent of Pandemonium
rules.description: One Shadowseer model in your army may be upgraded to the Agent of Pandemonium. All units within 3” of this unit in the Combat Phase gain the Gets Hot! Special rule on all equipped Melee weapons.

rules.name: Blitz
rules.description: Once per game, at the start of your Movement Phase, you may declare that this unit will Blitz. At the end of your turn, if this unit is alive and on the Battlefield, it may conduct another turn with a Movement Phase, Shooting Phase, Charge Phase and Combat Phase. The opponent then begins their next turn as normal.

rules.name: Thirsting Darkness
rules.description: One Solitaire model in your army may have this upgrade. A model with this upgrade gains the Frenzy, Furious Charge and Rage special rules.

rules.name: Prince of Sins
rules.description: One Solitaire model in your army may have this upgrade. The model gains the Hatred and Preferred Enemy special rules.

rules.name: Spectre of Despair
rules.description: One Solitaire model in your army may have this upgrade. This model gains the Deep Strike special rule. In addition, enemy units within 3” halve their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Player Roles
rules.comment: todo: No profile provided in reference

rules.name: The Great Harlequin
rules.description: A model with this upgrade gains +1 to their Wounds (W) characteristic and the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: The Prince of Light
rules.description: All friendly Harlequin units that can draw visibility to a unit with this upgrade may use this models Leadership (LD) characteristic for Pinning and Panic tests instead of their own.

rules.name: The Queen of Shards
rules.description: At Initiative Step 1 of the Combat Phase, all enemy units within 3” of a model with this upgrade take D6+2 Strength 1, AP- Automatic hits.

rules.name: The Veiled King
rules.description: A model with this upgrade gains +2 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Rising Crescendo
sharedRules.description: Units with this special rule can retreat in the Movement Phase and Charge in the Charge Phase.

sharedRules.name: Veiled tricksters
sharedRules.description: Veiled Path units that have the Fear (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

sharedRules.name: Defender of the Black Library
sharedRules.description: Twisted Path units gain the Hatred (Thousand Sons) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Hope of Eldar
sharedRules.description: Frozen Stars units gain the Stubborn special rule.

sharedRules.name: Malicious Amusement
sharedRules.description: All eligible Frozen Stars units with the Casting Call (x) special rule must select Casting Call (Dark).

sharedRules.name: Casting Call (Dark)
sharedRules.description: The unit gains the Rage special rule and may only join units with the Casting Call (Dark) special rule. If the unit is a Character, it may only take Warlord traits from the General Warlord Traits and Dark Warlord Traits.

sharedRules.name: Casting Call (Light)
sharedRules.description: The unit gains the Sudden Strike special rule and may only join units with the Casting Call (Light) special rule. If the unit is a Character, it may only take Warlord traits from the General Warlord Traits and Light Warlord Traits.

sharedRules.name: Casting Call (Twilight)
sharedRules.description: The unit gains the Fleet special rule and may only join units with the Casting Call (Twilight) special rule. If the unit is a Character, it may only take Warlord traits from the General Warlord Traits and Twlight Warlord Traits.

sharedRules.name: Cloaked in Darkness
sharedRules.description: All eligible Reapers Mirth units with the Casting Call (x) special rule must select Casting Call (Dark).

sharedRules.name: First Troupe of Ynnead
sharedRules.description:
In a turn in which any unit dies (friend or foe), a unit with this special rule
gains +1 to their Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristics until the start of the next turn.

sharedRules.name: Aerial Performance
sharedRules.description: Soaring Spite Sky Spinner and Sky Weaver units gain the Furious Charge special rule.

sharedRules.name: Caught in Twilight
sharedRules.description: All eligible Dreaming Sorrow units with the Casting Call (x) special rule must select Casting Call (Twilight).

sharedRules.name: Duty Above Desire
sharedRules.description: Dreaming Sorrow Mimes and Harlequins Troupes gain the Zealot special rule.

sharedRules.name: Shadow & Light
sharedRules.description: This unit can only select Twilight or Dark for Casting Call (x).

rules.name: Holo Field
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Mirage Mask
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear has the Fear (1) special rule.

rules.name: Flip Belt
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Fly and Move Through Cover special rules.

rules.name: Skyweaver Jetbike
rules.description: A model that is equipped with Jetbike becomes the Jetbike type. The Jetbike increases the models Toughness (T) by 1. The Jetbike is equipped with a Shuriken Cannon.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Variable, Poison (2+), Blast (Small), Precision Hits, Pinning

rules.name: A Foot in the Future
rules.description: A Warlord with this trait and ay attached unit gains the Sprint (3) special rule.

rules.name: A Heroes Call
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait and any attached unit gains the Scout special rule. In addition, gain +1 to the dice roll when determining who will take the first turn.

rules.name: A Trick of Light
rules.description: If your army includes a model with this Warlord Trait, after deployment but before the first Battle Round begins, you may re-deploy 3 units in your army.

rules.name: Dance of Infinite Mirrors
rules.description: Once per game, in your Movement Phase, you may remove a model with this Warlord trait and any attached unit from the Battlefield. Place them back down on the Battlefield anywhere more than 9” away from any enemy models. This counts as the units Normal Move that Phase.

rules.name: Dance Of Nightmares Made Flesh
rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of a model with this Warlord trait that must make a Panic test, before rolling their Panic test must subtract D6 from their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Fractal Storm
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait has a 3+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Luck of the Laughing God
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait may re-roll Hit Rolls and Save rolls of 1.

rules.name: Narrator of Wars
rules.description: If your army includes a model with this Warlord trait, and they are alive and on the Battlefield during Battle Round 4, you may declare that the battle ends or decare that the battle will be 6 Battle Rounds instead.

rules.name: The Final Joke
rules.description: When this Warlord would be removed from play and slain, the unit that inflicted the final wound which resulted in the Warlord being slain is automatically removed from play and counts as Slain/Wrecked.

rules.name: The Steps of Mortal Transition
rules.description: All Attacks by a model with this Warlord Trait are treated as having the Murderous Strike (6+) special rule.

rules.name: Twisted Encore
rules.description:
After the final Battle Round of a game has concluded, before any objectives are tallied or any further steps taken, a model with this Warlord trait that is alive and on the Battlefield may conduct an additional turn with a Movement,
Shooting, Charge and Combat Phase. The battle then concludes and Victory Points are calculated.

rules.name: Webway Walker
rules.description: If your army includes a model with this Warlord Trait, you can select up to D3 units in your army to gain the Deep Strike special rule.

modifiers.value: {unit} must have a power sword equipped to take {this}

rules.name: Starmist Raiment
rules.description: All Attacks against a model bearing this Relic are resolved as if the Attacking model is affected by the Blind special rule.

rules.name: The Laughing God’ss Eye
rules.description: A model with this Wargear and any attached unit gain the Adamantium Will and Deny the Witch special rules.

rules.name: The Mask of Secrets
rules.description: A model with this Relic Wargear increases their Fear (x) special rule to Fear (3).

rules.name: Dance of Shadows
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Feel no Pain (6+) special rule.

rules.name: Veil of Tears
rules.description: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker and any attached unit. The target unit may target the Psyker and their attached unit with Shooting Attacks in the Shooting Phase until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Mirror of Minds
rules.description: When this Psychic power is cast, select a single enemy model within 18” of the Psyker. The target model must make a Leadership Test. On a pass, they take 1 Automatic Wound with no saves allowed. If they fail, they take D3+1 Automatic Wounds with no saves allowed.

rules.name: Fog of Dreams
rules.description: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 12” of the Psyker and any attached unit. The target unit may only make Snap Shots in the Shooting Phase until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Casting Call (X)
rules.description:
A model with this special rule must select when Mustering your Army one of the following roles as (x):
o Light: The unit gains the Sudden Strike special rule and may only join units with the Casting Call (Light) special rule. If the unit is a Character, it may only take Warlord traits from the General Warlord Traits and Light Warlord Traits.
o Twilight: The unit gains the Fleet special rule and may only join units with the Casting Call (Twilight) special rule. If the unit is a Character, it may only take Warlord traits from the General Warlord Traits and Twlight Warlord Traits.
o Dark: The unit gains the Rage special rule and may only join units with the Casting Call (Dark) special rule. If the unit is a Character, it may only take Warlord traits from the General Warlord Traits and Dark Warlord Traits.
